title: Review and the Seen archive
spec: Marking a title watched asks for 1-5 stars (required) and an optional free-text review, stamps watched_at, sets status=seen and removes it from the queue without deleting it. The Seen archive is a BROWSABLE shelf, not a graveyard: cover art, stars, the date, the review, sortable by date watched and by rating, filterable by kind. Un-watching returns a title to the end of the queue and keeps the review. ACCEPT: rating a title moves it out of the queue and into Seen with its art intact; the archive is worth opening on its own.
